subproblem.title: Tangent projections of an embedded C¹ submanifold have rank m and vary continuously along M (parent steps 0.1, 0.3)
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M). For x ∈ ℝ^P write S_x := span_ℝ(tangentSpace M x) and P_x := S_x.starProjection, the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto S_x viewed as a continuous linear map ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Then (a) dim S_x = m for every x ∈ M; (b) x ↦ P_x is continuous on M (relative topology on M, operator norm on L(ℝ^P)); (c) for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P the function x ↦ trace(P_x ∘ DX(x)) (DX(x) = fderiv ℝ X x) is continuous on M.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = m) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M ∧ ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ContinuousOn (fun x => LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap)) M
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps (0.1) and (0.3) of the supplied proof of the parent (Simon Ch. 2, §4: charts (4.1) and T_yM; book/chapter-02.txt). Dependency: chart_tangent (Submission.dsmc_chart_tangentSpace_eq_range): if (V, W, ψ) is a chart as in IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N with r ≥ 1 and v ∈ V, then (i) tangentSpace N (ψ v) = range Dψ(v), and (ii) for every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that v' ∈ V and |ψ(v') − ψ(v)| < δ imply |v' − v| < ε.

1. (Span of a range.) For a continuous linear D : ℝ^m → ℝ^P the set range D is the carrier of the linear subspace LinearMap.range D, so span(range D) = range D (LinearMap.coe_range, Submodule.span_eq).

2. (Projection formula.) Let D : ℝ^m → ℝ^P be linear and injective, D* its adjoint and G := D*D : ℝ^m → ℝ^m.
 (a) G is injective: if Gw = 0 then |Dw|² = ⟨D*Dw, w⟩ = ⟨Gw, w⟩ = 0, so Dw = 0 and w = 0 by injectivity of D. An injective linear endomorphism of the finite-dimensional space ℝ^m is bijective (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective), hence a unit of the ring L(ℝ^m) (ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective).
 (b) Put R := D ∘ G⁻¹ ∘ D*, where G⁻¹ = Ring.inverse G. Let h ∈ ℝ^P and y := G⁻¹D*h; then Gy = D*h (Ring.mul_inverse_cancel) and Rh = Dy ∈ range D. For every x ∈ ℝ^m, ⟨h − Dy, Dx⟩ = ⟨D*(h − Dy), x⟩ = ⟨D*h − Gy, x⟩ = 0, so h − Rh is orthogonal to range D. By the characterization of the orthogonal projection (Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero: u ∈ K and h − u ⊥ K imply P_K h = u), (range D).starProjection h = Rh. Hence (range D).starProjection = D ∘ (D*D)⁻¹ ∘ D*.

3. (Chart data.) Let y ∈ M and let (V, W, ψ) be a chart at y given by IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M: V ⊆ ℝ^m and W ⊆ ℝ^P open, y ∈ W, ψ C¹ on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for compact K ⊆ W, Dψ(z) injective for z ∈ V. Since y ∈ W ∩ M = ψ(V), y = ψ(v₀) with v₀ ∈ V. By chart_tangent (r = 1) and step 1, S_{ψ(v)} = span(range Dψ(v)) = range Dψ(v) for every v ∈ V, and ψ⁻¹ is continuous in the sense (ii) at every ψ(v), v ∈ V.

4. (Part (a).) Let x ∈ M; take a chart at x as in step 3 and write x = ψ(v), v ∈ V. Then S_x = range Dψ(v), and since Dψ(v) is injective, dim range Dψ(v) = dim ℝ^m = m (LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin).

5. (Part (b).) Fix y ∈ M and a chart as in step 3, y = ψ(v₀). Write D(v) := Dψ(v).
 (a) Since ψ is C¹ on the open set V, v ↦ D(v) is continuous on V (ContDiffOn.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen). The adjoint A ↦ A* is a linear isometry, hence continuous, so v ↦ D(v)* is continuous on V, and so is v ↦ G(v) := D(v)*D(v) (composition of continuous linear maps is jointly continuous, ContinuousOn.clm_comp).
 (b) Each G(v), v ∈ V, is a unit by step 2(a), and inversion is continuous at every unit of the complete normed ring L(ℝ^m) (NormedRing.inverse_continuousAt). Hence v ↦ G(v)⁻¹ and R(v) := D(v)G(v)⁻¹D(v)* are continuous on V; as V is open, R is continuous at v₀.
 (c) By step 2(b) and step 3, P_{ψ(v)} = (range D(v)).starProjection = R(v) for every v ∈ V.
 (d) Let ε > 0. Choose ρ > 0 with ‖R(v) − R(v₀)‖ < ε whenever |v − v₀| < ρ (continuity at v₀). By (ii) choose δ₁ > 0 such that v ∈ V and |ψ(v) − y| < δ₁ imply |v − v₀| < ρ. Since W is open choose δ₂ > 0 with ball(y, δ₂) ⊆ W. Let x ∈ M with |x − y| < min(δ₁, δ₂). Then x ∈ W ∩ M = ψ(V), so x = ψ(v) with v ∈ V and |v − v₀| < ρ, whence ‖P_x − P_y‖ = ‖R(v) − R(v₀)‖ < ε by (c). So x ↦ P_x is continuous within M at y; y ∈ M was arbitrary.

6. (Part (c).) Let X be C¹. Then x ↦ DX(x) is continuous (ContDiff.continuous_fderiv), so x ↦ P_x ∘ DX(x) is continuous on M by (b) (ContinuousOn.clm_comp). The map T ↦ trace(T) on the finite-dimensional space L(ℝ^P) is linear, hence continuous (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional applied to (LinearMap.trace ℝ ℝ^P) ∘ (coercion L(ℝ^P) → End(ℝ^P))). Since the linear map underlying P_x ∘ DX(x) is P_x.toLinearMap ∘ₗ DX(x).toLinearMap, the function x ↦ trace(P_x.toLinearMap ∘ₗ DX(x).toLinearMap) is continuous on M. ∎

theorem Submission.codim1_hcp_fv_tangent_projection_continuousOn : ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = m) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M ∧ ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ContinuousOn (fun x => LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap)) M := by
  intro P m M hM
  -- span of the range of a continuous linear map is its range
  have hspan_range : ∀ D : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid P,
      Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range D) = LinearMap.range (D : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) := by
    intro D
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ← LinearMap.coe_range, Submodule.span_eq]
  -- for injective D, the Gram operator DᵀD is a unit and P_{range D} = D (DᵀD)⁻¹ Dᵀ
  have hproj : ∀ D : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid P, Injective D →
      IsUnit (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D) ∧
      (LinearMap.range (D : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)).starProjection =
        D ∘L (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D) := by
    intro D hD
    set G := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D ∘L D with hG_def
    have hGinj : Injective G := by
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro w hw
      apply hD
      rw [map_zero]
      have hnorm : ‖D w‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
        change inner ℝ (G w) w = 0
        rw [hw, inner_zero_left]
      exact norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hnorm)
    have hGunit : IsUnit G := ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.mpr
      ⟨hGinj, (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := (G : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid m))).mp hGinj⟩
    refine ⟨hGunit, ?_⟩
    ext1 h
    set y := Ring.inverse G (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D h)
    have hGy : G y = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D h := by
      rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hGunit, one_apply_eq_self]
    change _ = D y
    refine Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_of_inner_eq_zero
      (LinearMap.mem_range_self (D : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) y) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, map_sub]
    change inner ℝ (_ - G y) x = 0
    rw [hGy, sub_self, inner_zero_left]
  -- local chart data: span T_{ψ v} = range Dψ(v), and ψ⁻¹ is continuous on W ∩ M
  have hlocal : ∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (V : Set (Euclid m)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P),
      IsOpen V ∧ IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V ∧ ψ '' V = W ∩ M ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ V, Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (ψ v)) =
        LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ v : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ v' ∈ V, dist (ψ v') (ψ v) < δ → dist v' v < ε) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨V, W, ψ, hV, hW, hyW, hψ, hinj, himg, hprop, hder⟩ := hM y hy
    refine ⟨V, W, ψ, hV, hW, hyW, hψ, himg, hder, fun v hv => ?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    · have h := (Submission.dsmc_chart_tangentSpace_eq_range P 1 m M V W ψ le_rfl hV hW hψ hinj
        himg hprop hder v hv).1
      rw [h, hspan_range]
    · exact (Submission.dsmc_chart_tangentSpace_eq_range P 1 m M V W ψ le_rfl hV hW hψ hinj
        himg hprop hder v hv).2.1
  -- (a) the tangent space has dimension m
  have hfin : ∀ x ∈ M, Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = m := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨V, W, ψ, hV, hW, hxW, hψ, himg, hder, hsp, -⟩ := hlocal x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ : x ∈ ψ '' V := by rw [himg]; exact ⟨hxW, hx⟩
    rw [hsp v hv, LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (hder v hv), finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
  -- (b) continuity of x ↦ P_x on M
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨V, W, ψ, hV, hW, hyW, hψ, himg, hder, hsp, hinv⟩ := hlocal y hy
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, rfl⟩ : y ∈ ψ '' V := by rw [himg]; exact ⟨hyW, hy⟩
    have hD : ContinuousOn (fun v => fderiv ℝ ψ v) V := hψ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV le_rfl
    have hadj : Continuous (fun A : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid P => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Euclid m) (F := Euclid P)).continuous
    have hDt : ContinuousOn (fun v => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v)) V :=
      hadj.comp_continuousOn hD
    have hG : ContinuousOn
        (fun v => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ v) V :=
      hDt.clm_comp hD
    have hGinv : ContinuousOn (fun v =>
        Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ v)) V := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hproj _ (hder v hv)).1
      have hinvc := NormedRing.inverse_continuousAt u
      rw [hu] at hinvc
      exact hinvc.comp_continuousWithinAt
        (f := fun v => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ v) (hG v hv)
    have hR : ContinuousOn (fun v => fderiv ℝ ψ v ∘L (Ring.inverse
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v))) V :=
      hD.clm_comp (hGinv.clm_comp hDt)
    have hPR : ∀ v ∈ V, (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (ψ v))).starProjection =
        fderiv ℝ ψ v ∘L (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L
          fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v)) := by
      intro v hv
      rw [← (hproj _ (hder v hv)).2]
      congr 1
      exact hsp v hv
    rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hRat : ContinuousAt (fun v => fderiv ℝ ψ v ∘L (Ring.inverse
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∘L
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ v))) v₀ :=
      hR.continuousAt (hV.mem_nhds hv₀)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρR⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hRat ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁inv⟩ := hinv v₀ hv₀ ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hδ₂W⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW (ψ v₀) hyW
    refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂, fun {x} hxM hxy => ?_⟩
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hδ₂W (lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (min_le_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ : x ∈ ψ '' V := by rw [himg]; exact ⟨hxW, hxM⟩
    have hvv : dist v v₀ < ρ := hδ₁inv v hv (lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (min_le_left _ _))
    rw [hPR v hv, hPR v₀ hv₀]
    exact hρR hvv
  -- (c) continuity of the tangential divergence of a C¹ field on M
  refine ⟨hfin, hcont, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  have htr : Continuous (fun T : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P =>
      LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) :=
    LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
      ((LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.coeLM ℝ))
  have hcomp : ContinuousOn (fun x =>
      (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection ∘L fderiv ℝ X x) M :=
    hcont.clm_comp (hX.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).continuousOn
  refine (htr.comp_continuousOn hcomp).congr fun x _ => ?_
  simp

proof_key_steps: Span of range Dψ(v) is range Dψ(v); for injective D, (range D).starProjection = D(D*D)⁻¹D* (orthogonality characterization).
Chart lemma: S_{ψ(v)} = range Dψ(v) on the chart domain, so dim S_x = m on M.
v ↦ Dψ(v)(Dψ(v)*Dψ(v))⁻¹Dψ(v)* is continuous on V (adjoint isometry, Ring.inverse continuous at units).
Continuity of ψ⁻¹ on W ∩ M transfers continuity to x ↦ P_x on M; trace ∘ composition gives continuity of div_M X.
